name: Extra Portal Trick
body:
Through constant practice, you can use your ability to travel through portals in a new and creative way.

Prerequisite(s): create portal class feature, base attack bonus +4.

Benefit(s): You can learn a new portal trick.

Special: You can gain the Extra Portal Trick multiple times. Each time, you select a new portal trick you don’t yet know.
